title: The block under the move
prompt: It is 10:02 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: A steady move doesn't leave one big gap. Look for the candle where it began, and for what price did to the liquidity just before.
intro.advanced: 10:02 ET. A steady move. Where's the entry?

whyNot.label: hunting for one big gap
whyNot.why: The displacement was steady rather than explosive, so the gaps it left are small and stacked along the way. The order block, the last down candle before the move, is the origin: a single, defined area with the stop just beneath it.

whyNot.label: the bearish gap in the pullback
whyNot.why: Against the move. It's the retrace.

reference.summary: Sell-side liquidity swept, a steady displacement through the last 5m high, and a retrace all the way into the last down candle before it: the order block. The small gap just above it is an acceptable alternative. The previous day high is the draw.

bias.why: Higher highs and higher lows on the Daily and 4H; the overnight dip was a pullback.

decision.why: A valid long: the entry is the order block. Waiting for the retrace into it is equally sound.

take.why: Liquidity taken, displacement, a defined area and a draw.

draw.why: The previous day high is the pool above.

next_objective.why: Price was drawn to the previous day high (21,535); it also traded to the unfilled gap at 21,399.5 to 21,419.75 on the way, which makes those defensible too. The question is where price was likely to be pulled, not what the next candle would do. A previous-day extreme is also a pool of buy-side or sell-side liquidity, so that answer is right on the side, if less exact.

annotations.label: 5m order block: the last down candle before the move
annotations.why: The candle the displacement started from. A retrace into its range is the entry.
annotations.decisionNote: When the move is steady the block is the cleaner origin: a defined area and a stop just beyond the sweep.

annotations.label: Small 5m gap just above the block
annotations.why: The first gap the move left, sitting on top of the block. An acceptable alternative area.

annotations.label: Overnight low 21,380
annotations.why: The sell-side liquidity swept at the open.

confluences.label: Entry from the order block
confluences.why: A defined origin for the move.

confluences.label: "There's no single big gap"
confluences.why: The block is the setup here; waiting for a textbook gap would miss it.

trade.confirmationLabel: the displacement that closed above the last 5m high

lookFor: When there's no gap, look for the last opposing candle before the move.
The area has to come from the move that took the liquidity, not from anywhere that looks like a candle.

provenance.note: Constructed price path, not market history.
